newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Sidmar to takeover British steel centres.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Sidmar to takeover British steel centres.

text.p: Sidmar, a Belgian unit of Luxembourg steelmaker Arbed, said it was acquiring the share capital of U.K.-steel centres Howard E Perry and subsidiary Hughes & Spencer Steel from Germany's Kloeckner Stahl Und Metallhandel GmbH.
It gave no financial details of the deal.
"Through this acquisition Sidmar will gain control of a steel service centre group that is already a significant processor of its products," Sidmar said in a statement.
The agreement was conditional on the approval of the boards of directors and the European authorities.
Sidmar said its position would be significantly strengthened in the U.K. market where it was currently represented by Willenhall Steel Stockholders Ltd.
Howard E Perry and Hughes & Spencer Steel are situated in the West Midlands area of Britain and have a combined production of 150,000 tonnes a year.
The statement said that for Kloeckner Stahl Und Metallhandel the move constituted a further stage in its concentration on European steel distribution.
